data.title: PRE ARCON 2025
data.description:
The 8th Annual Scientific Conference & AGM of the Association of Radiation and Clinical Oncologists of Nigeria (ARCON) is more than a gathering — it’s a catalyst for change in cancer care across Africa.

ARCON 2025 brings together clinicians, researchers, students, policymakers, and innovators from across the oncology ecosystem to explore groundbreaking ideas, share cutting-edge research, and forge bold collaborations.

This year’s theme, “Innovation Through Collaboration: Cultivating a Resilient Nigerian Oncology Ecosystem,” reflects our commitment to driving sustainable solutions through collective effort.

Expect immersive sessions on AI in oncology, climate change and cancer, enterprise in cancer care, and more — all designed to inspire, challenge, and equip.

Join us as we shape the future of oncology in Nigeria and beyond.

Be part of the movement. Be part of ARCON 2025.
data.address: Obi Wali International Conference Centre, G.U Ake Road Port Harcourt

data.title: LIMCAF 2025 GRAND FINALE
data.description:
The Life In My City Art Festival (LIMCAF) 2025 Grand Finale
The Life In My City Art Festival (LIMCAF) stands as Nigeria’s biggest and longest-running annual visual arts festival, a pioneering platform dedicated to discovering, celebrating, and empowering young artists across the nation. For nearly two decades, LIMCAF has continued to shape the landscape of contemporary Nigerian art, fostering creativity, cultural exchange, and national development.
Hosted in the vibrant city of Enugu, Nigeria, the LIMCAF 2025 Grand Finale will bring together the Top 100 young artists from across the country, whose exceptional works have emerged from regional competitions held nationwide. This landmark gathering will unite artists, patrons, collectors, and cultural leaders in a week-long celebration of art, innovation, and excellence.
Through exhibitions, lectures, tours, craft showcases, and the prestigious Gala and Award Night, the Grand Finale reaffirms LIMCAF’s enduring mission to position art at the heart of social and national development by providing opportunity, mentorship, and visibility for Nigeria’s next generation of creatives.
Join us in Enugu this October as we celebrate the spirit of creativity and the transformative power of art.

data.title: AI Nigeria Summit 2026: Shaping the Future with Intelligence
data.description:
Join us for the premier Artificial Intelligence conference in Nigeria, the AI Nigeria Summit 2026. This two-day event will bring together leading researchers, industry experts, innovators, and enthusiasts to explore the latest advancements, applications, and ethical considerations in AI. Dive deep into topics such as machine learning, deep learning, natural language processing, computer vision, robotics, and AI's impact on various sectors including healthcare, finance, and education.

The summit will feature engaging keynote speeches, interactive panel discussions, hands-on workshops, and a vibrant exhibition area showcasing cutting-edge AI technologies and solutions. Network with peers, discover new opportunities, and gain valuable insights that will empower you to leverage AI for innovation and growth. Whether you are an AI professional, an aspiring data scientist, a business leader, or simply curious about the future of intelligence, this summit is designed to inspire and inform.
